pair_support_bound.method: FP64 analytic finite-cylinder support functions with additional numerically searched directions. Every searched direction is re-evaluated analytically, so optimization failure cannot create a false clearance claim. Every pair and saved state. Candidate support directions bound minimum separating translation from above; small positive values do not prove intersection. Substep tunneling and physical coin rim geometry are outside this audit.

limits: Fingertips use authored planar compliant rubber boxes.
Arm follows prescribed joint positions; no motor dynamics or full robot mesh contact.
This checks pose/contact placement, not force calibration.
stock_grip_alignment.physical_input_precision: Native path reader casts CSV pose fields to FP32; the exported forces and contact points come from the GPU contact buffer.
stock_grip_alignment.normal_force_definition: Legacy channel names denote negative-normal and positive-normal planes respectively. Values are position contact multipliers divided by dt squared; velocity impulses act at the same recorded nodes.

limits: Prescribed Panda joint trajectory; motor dynamics are not simulated.
Film and pad properties/friction are assumed, not calibrated.
Finite compliant contact patches coincide with the authored rubber fingertip faces. Full robot/film mesh collisions and motor dynamics are not simulated.
Numerical geometry and energy checks are not physical validation.
